privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.lead: How we collect, use and protect the data of our guests and of visitors to this site.

ps.t: [Company name], [legal form], [address], Greece. General Commercial Registry (GEMI) [number], tax number (AFM) [number]. We run Amour Relax Hotel (MHTE [number]) and Villa Eudora ([MHTE or AMA number]).
For anything about your data, write to [privacy email].
When you book: your name, email, phone, dates, number of guests and any requests. Card details go straight to the secure payment page of our booking engine; we never see or keep the full card number.
When you write to us: your name, email, dates and message. When you visit the site: cookies and similar data, only with your consent (see the cookie policy).

To take and run your booking (a contract with you). To keep accounting records and register guests as Greek law requires (a legal duty). To answer your questions. To send news and offers only if you ask for them (your consent, which you can withdraw at any time). To measure and improve the site, only with your consent.

Our booking engine (BookOnlineNow), channel manager (HotelAvailabilities) and hotel management system (CloudHotel); the bank that processes card payments; [newsletter service]; Google and Meta for analytics and ads, only with your consent; our accountant; public authorities when the law requires it. Each works under a data processing agreement with us.
Some providers, such as Google and Meta, may process data outside the EU. They do so under the safeguards of EU data protection law, such as standard contractual clauses.
Booking and accounting records: as long as Greek tax law requires [… years]. Messages: [… months] after our last contact. Newsletter: until you unsubscribe. Cookies: see the cookie policy.
You can ask to see, correct or delete your data, to limit or object to its use, to take it with you, and to withdraw your consent at any time. Write to [privacy email]; we answer within one month.
You can also complain to the Hellenic Data Protection Authority (www.dpa.gr).
We update this policy when our services change. The date at the top shows the latest version.

cookies.title: Cookie policy
cookies.lead: Which cookies this site uses, why, and how to change your choice.

ps.t: Small files a site saves in your browser, so it can remember your choices or count visits.

On your first visit you choose: accept all or reject. Both buttons are equal. Analytics, ads, maps and videos load only after you accept. You can change your choice at any time with "Cookie settings" at the bottom of every page.
[The list is completed when the site, the booking engine and analytics are set up.]
In your browser settings you can see and delete cookies at any time. If you block all cookies, the booking engine may not work.
We update this list every time we add or remove a service.

terms.title: Booking terms
terms.lead: The conditions of a booking made on this site.

ps.t: [Company name], [address], Greece, tax number (AFM) [number], which runs Amour Relax Hotel (MHTE [number]) and Villa Eudora ([MHTE or AMA number]).
You book on this site through our booking engine. The full amount is charged when you book, by card, on its secure payment page. Prices include VAT. You must be 18 or over to book.
Greece charges a climate resilience fee per room per night. It is not part of the price and is paid at the hotel: [€… per room per night].

[Standard rate: free cancellation up to … days before arrival; after that …]. [Non-refundable rate, if offered: the full amount is charged at booking and not refunded.] The rule of each rate is shown next to its price and in your confirmation.
To change your dates, write to us; we help if the room is free. No-show: [ … ].
Bookings of three rooms or more, of the whole hotel, or for a celebration at the villa follow separate written conditions: deposit and payment dates agreed with us.
Check-in from 14:00, check-out until 11:00. Please tell us your arrival time. [Online check-in before arrival.]
Children are welcome; our rooms suit guests from 12 years best, the villa suits any age. Pets are welcome [conditions]. Celebrations only at the villa, agreed in advance. [Quiet hours, smoking.]
[Liability for belongings and damage, deposit for the villa: written with the lawyer.] If something is wrong, tell us on the spot and we put it right. Greek law applies to these terms.
